name: Layout Builder + Edit + (Deprecated)
description: Deprecated. Functionality moved into lb_plus; the module exists only so database updates can uninstall it.
project_description:
Layout Builder+ is the Edit Mode native version of Layout Builder for the + Suite page builder .

 
 

 
 ▶ Watch an introduction to +Suite 

 Layout Builder + brings the power of Drupal cores Layout Builder to the + Suite page builder . Place, Change, Move, Delete and Duplicate blocks with easy to use photoshop-like tools. Layout Builder + also adds support for sortable sections, nested Layout Blocks and much more!
